title: Quadratic cost bound
statement: For natural numbers $S,B,t,w,s,d$, suppose $w\le t$, $s\le 4w+S$, and $d\le (B+2w+8)(t+1)$. Then $s+d\le (S+B+14)(t+1)^2$.
replaced:
For all natural numbers $S$, $B$, $t$, $w$, $s$, $d$: if $w \le t$,
$s \le 4w + S$, and $d \le (B + 2w + 8)(t+1)$, then
$s + d \le (S + B + 14)(t+1)^2$.
